newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian GDP trend a concern-industry group.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian GDP trend a concern-industry group.

text.p: The Australian Chamber of Commerce and Industry said on Wednesday it was concerned about the slowing of trend GDP growth.
"A reversal of this downwards trend is essential if an acceptable economic growth rate is to be maintained," chief executive Mark Paterson said in a statement.
Trend GDP growth slowed to 0.5 percent in the September quarter, according to data released on Wednesday, down from 0.8 percent in the June quarter and 1.2 percent in the March quarter.
However, Paterson said the GDP figures were generally in line with expectations and were consistent with the rate forecast in the government's August 20 budget.

Seasonally adjusted average gross domestic product rose 0.8 percent in the September quarter for an annual rate of 3.8 percent. Most economists had forecast September quarter GDP-A to rise 0.9 percent for an annual rate of around 3.4 percent.
"If the current growth rate can be maintained, this will provide stability and a firmer foundation for more rapid growth next year and in the years to follow," Paterson said.
